```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(data.table)
library(VennDiagram)
futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")
library(grid)
library(pheatmap)

data_storage_folder = "../../../Data/Processed/Huang"
```


```{r}
order_df <- function(d, column, decreasing = F) {return(d[order(d[[column]], decreasing = decreasing),])}
```


```{r}
# Data is from 450k array, but the WGBS data annotations have only IDs for the Illumina EPIC, so we might lose approx 27k CpGs
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
full_anno_epic = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
cpg_pos_epic <- full_anno_epic[, c("chr","pos")] |> as.data.frame()
rm(full_anno_epic)
gc()
cpg_pos_epic_ranges <- with(cpg_pos_epic, GRanges(chr, IRanges(start=pos, end=pos), ID=rownames(cpg_pos_epic)) )
```


# WGS atlas data

  - DM sites between Colon and Antrum or SI and Antrum

```{r}
all_results_beta_annotated_wgs <- readRDS("../../../Data/Processed/WGBS/WGS_gut_DM.rds")

# wgs_all_ilmn <- lapply(all_results_beta_annotated_wgs, function(x) {
#   x <- subset(x, !is.na(ilmn_id))
#   x$dge_class <- ifelse(x$adj.P.Val > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(x$logFC > 0, ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(x$logFC < -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))
#   x$direction <- ifelse(x$adj.P.Val > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(abs(x$logFC) < 0.2, "nc/weak", ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hypo")))
#   return(x)
# })

wgs_all_ilmn <- lapply(all_results_beta_annotated_wgs, function(x) {
  x <- subset(x, !is.na(ilmn_id))
  x$dge_class <- ifelse(x$adj.P.Val > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(x$logFC > 0, ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(x$logFC < -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))
  x$direction <- ifelse(x$adj.P.Val > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(x$logFC > 0, "hyper", "hypo"))
  return(x)
})
```


# IM DM results

See DGE_Result_Overview.html for definitions of hyper/hypomethylated CpG cutoff values.


<!-- ```{r} -->
<!-- load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists.Rdata")) -->
<!-- ``` -->


```{r}
load("../../../Data/Processed/Huang/all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_annotated.RData")

all_hyper_cpg <- list()
all_hypo_cpg <- list()

for (n in names(all_results_betas_annotated)) {
  tmp <- all_results_betas_annotated[[n]]
  all_hyper_cpg[[n]]  <- subset(tmp, logFC > 0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  all_hypo_cpg[[n]]  <- subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
}

```


## Hyper-CpGs

```{r}
sapply(all_hyper_cpg, nrow)
```

## Hypo-CpGs

```{r}
sapply(all_hypo_cpg, nrow)
```


## Overlap with WGS atlas gut DM sites

### CpGs DM in IM vs. nonIM (only new samples)

```{r}
comp = "IMvsNonIM_Antrum"
```


```{r}
all_ovlp_hyper <- list()
all_ovlp_hypo <- list()

for (n in names(wgs_all_ilmn)) {
  tmp <- wgs_all_ilmn[[n]]
  tmp$comparison_wgs <- n
  all_ovlp_hyper[[n]] <- merge(all_hyper_cpg[[comp]], tmp, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.x=T, sort=F)
  all_ovlp_hypo[[n]] <- merge(all_hypo_cpg[[comp]], tmp, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.x=T, sort=F)
}

all_ovlp_hyper_df <- do.call(rbind, all_ovlp_hyper)
all_ovlp_hypo_df <- do.call(rbind, all_ovlp_hypo)
```


```{r}
table(all_ovlp_hyper_df$comparison_wgs, all_ovlp_hyper_df$direction, useNA = "ifany", dnn=c("Comparison", "direction in WGS within IM-hypermethylated CpG"))
table(all_ovlp_hypo_df$comparison_wgs, all_ovlp_hypo_df$direction, useNA = "ifany", dnn=c("Comparison", "direction in WGS within IM-hypomethylated CpG"))
```


```{r}
table(all_ovlp_hyper_df$comparison_wgs, all_ovlp_hyper_df$dge_class, useNA = "ifany", dnn=c("Comparison", "direction in WGS within IM-hypermethylated CpG"))
table(all_ovlp_hypo_df$comparison_wgs, all_ovlp_hypo_df$dge_class, useNA = "ifany", dnn=c("Comparison", "direction in WGS within IM-hypomethylated CpG"))
```

#### CpGs DM in WGS colon/SI vs. stomach compared to IM DM CpGs

```{r}
dm_im <- rbind(all_hyper_cpg[[comp]], all_hypo_cpg[[comp]])
dm_im$direction_im <- ifelse(dm_im$logFC > 0, "hyper","hypo")
```


```{r}
all_ovlp_wgs <- list()

for (n in names(wgs_all_ilmn)) {
  tmp <- wgs_all_ilmn[[n]]
  tmp$comparison_wgs <- n
  all_ovlp_wgs[[n]] <- merge(dm_im, tmp, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.y=T, sort=F)
  all_ovlp_wgs[[n]]$direction_im <- ifelse(is.na(all_ovlp_wgs[[n]]$direction_im), "ns",all_ovlp_wgs[[n]]$direction_im)
}

```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
for (n in names(all_ovlp_wgs)) {
  m <- with(all_ovlp_wgs[[n]], table(direction_im, direction, dnn=c("DM IM vs. healthy", paste0("DM WGS ", n)))) 
  print(m)
  prop.table(m, margin=1) |> pheatmap::pheatmap(cluster_cols=F, cluster_rows=F, main=paste0("DM IM vs. healthy (rows) vs. WGS ", n, " (cols)")) |> print()
  prop.table(m, margin=1) |> round(digits = 3) |> print()
  csq <- chisq.test(m)
  csq.res <- csq$residuals |> as.matrix()
  print(csq)
  print(csq.res)
  pheatmap(csq.res[c("hyper","ns","hypo"), c("hyper","ns","hypo")], cluster_cols = F, cluster_rows=F, breaks = seq(-qchisq(0.95, 4), qchisq(0.95, 4), length.out = 100), main=n )
  assocplot(m, main=n)
}
```
